Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the positive development in your demand forecast and appreciate the transparency. In response to this increased volume, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €369.76. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current Angebot is a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms with a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We have maintained the 30-day payment term to ensure we can provide you with the most competitive unit price possible. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.76 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €371.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. Below this price we would need facts, not just a lower number. Any further step needs approval from our management. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
